mostWorthwhile.text: Making tides was most worthwhile: the Moon's uneven pull and the Sun's contribution gave the moving shore a useful explanation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding water to the rain-filled hollows felt predictable, though it completed the gradual buildup to an ocean.

surprise.text: I was interested that the growing rocky world heated up as its pieces struck and joined.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the sequence had clear purposes, although most steps offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the gradual construction and concise physical details made me curious about what the world would make next.
